# Matt VAPT Kit

Use Python's unittest suite and Docker smoke checks. Preserve existing Git hooks.
Never run live scans without a matching, unexpired scope approval. Never deploy
applications or upload findings to public services. Keep report data out of Git.

## Design Context

Audience: Matthew and his development team, reviewing practical security actions.
Tone: clear, trustworthy, practical. Use a light briefing layout with ink-blue
headings, clear warning labels and large readable screenshots. Keep it distinct
from CERT-PH reports. Lead with impact, show uncertainty and coverage gaps, retain
searchable evidence text, redact sensitive data, and make no external requests.
